run_update_clang: run the script to download and unpack prebuilt clang binaries for the current platform
download_url_with_retry: download a URL into an output file with progress dots and automatic retry on failure
download_and_unpack_tarball: download a gzipped tarball from a URL and extract it to a specified output directory
read_and_write_stamp_file: read or write a version stamp file to track which clang build is currently installed
remove_directory_tree: recursively delete a directory tree with automatic chmod retry for read-only files
